The '''Thesh protocol''' was a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind control]] protocol used on [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Cipher Nine]] by the order of the [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]] after the [[Dark Council]] showed concern following Cipher's confrontation with [[Darth Jadus]]. However, [[Star Cabal]] agent Hunter, who pretended to work for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], leaked the protocols and the control word to former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ardun Kothe]], who reprogrammed Cipher and let himself and [[Strategic Information Service strike team|his team]] inflict control over the Agent, now part of their team as "[[Legate]]." With the help of [[Watcher X]] Cipher Nine was eventually able to learn of the protocols and subvert them.
